{"notes": "Visit 2 (left 3:45). I only see what happens while I'm at the table and don't know who placed which dominoes. The picture shows one continuous dark chain from the start (~28,4) along the top, round the nose at ~(4.5,11), and back along the bottom to ~(19.5,12.2). There are no pale or broken pieces and the nose joint is intact. The bottom line exists and is connected, so my visit 1 question is answered. It is about two-thirds of the way along. It still has to reach the tail end, and it's unclear whether they will finish on time.

Sofia: Said the bottom line was going down, was about halfway at 3:15, and the bin was fine. All of this matches the picture, so her reports look accurate. She is engaged and updating the team, so my visit 1 worry that she was left out is resolved. I can't confirm she placed the dominoes herself, so I'm only crediting the accurate reporting. Still to ask her privately: how the handoff from Omar felt and whether she needs help finishing.

Omar: Gave encouraging updates at 3:00, 3:15 and 3:30, stayed out of Sofia's way, and said he'd check the tail. I saw no checking or building by him, so I can't credit any work beyond supportive coordination. His plan to inspect the tail should be tested at the next visit. Visit 1 handoff concern: it worked out.

Jack: Said the nose joint looked good and he'd watch the bottom line for gaps. No gaps are visible. He is positive and team-minded, but I saw no direct contribution, so his rating is still undetermined.

Hana: Absent from this visit's comments, so I have no new evidence. Bin is reported fine by Sofia, which is consistent with supply working. Don't infer anything either way.

Next visit: check the tail connection and whether anyone is actually doing the checking they've promised. Ask each person privately who did what."}
